senses.zh_definition: 艾莉森：英语人名或姓氏；在马来语文本中作为专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: Allison: an English-language personal name or surname, used as a proper noun in Malay text.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, sama ada nama diri atau nama keluarga, yang digunakan dalam bahasa Inggeris; bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 输入包没有提供 DBP 释义，不能据此认定为官方马来语普通词，故标为 unverified。IPA 为英语读音；noun 在此指 kata nama khas。排名沿用输入数据，不代表普通马来词的使用频率。下列为姓名的句法用例，不是已证实的高频固定搭配。[Cambridge 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/allison)、[姓氏词典资料](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Allison)。

etymology.historical_story: As a given name, Allison is a spelling variant of Alison, historically connected with Alice. As a surname, Allison has several English and Scottish histories, including formations involving Alice or Alison. These naming traditions should not be collapsed into a Malay word meaning: a person's name identifies its bearer rather than describing that person's character. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/alison), [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Allison).
